title: TeamGeneratorConfig
description: The named parameters of the team generator (ADR-013 section 2). Level, team size, the Stat Point total and the Item Clause are not here: they come from the pinned engine's rule table. Every value is an integer, and a wrong value only changes how many draws the engine rejects, because the validator judges every team. The sorted and unique item list and the item ids' existence are enforced by the reader and the checker. Its RFC 8785 SHA-256 is the config hash.

stat_point_max_per_stat.description: The most Stat Points a draw puts into one stat.

moves_per_set.description: The most moves a draw gives a set. The proposal needs it (the generator refuses a config without it); the validator judges the result, so a wrong value only raises the rejection rate. Optional in the contract so that configs written before it still read.

gender_policy.description: unset leaves gender to the engine; random draws it.

nickname_policy.description: none gives no nickname; species gives the species name.

default_item_weight.description: The weight of an item the list below does not name.

item_weights.description: Weights that override the default, sorted by item id and unique.

items.description: An item and its integer draw weight.

d_max.description: D_max: the most draws of the single stream one plan may use.

pilot_draws.description: The draws of the recorded pilot (at least 40,000).

pilot_min_hits.description: The fewest pilot hits a cell needs to count as affordable.

n_stratum_min.description: The fewest teams every cell must have in each split.

fill_quantile_permille.description: The quantile of a cell's fill time the plan is sized for, in thousandths (990 is 0.99).

sealed_margin_permille.description: How far a sealed plan is over-provisioned, in thousandths.

range_draws_log2.description: The stream is split into ranges of 2^this draws.

range_margin_permille.description: The extra ranges provisioned beyond the planned stream length, in thousandths (100 is 10 percent).

two_platform_bound.description: Up to this many teams both platforms run the whole pipeline.

sampled_ranges.description: Above the bound, the second platform recomputes this many ranges.

proposal.description: Optional (a minor change within v1): the proposal is a mixture of components, each drawn with its share (ADR-020 section 2). Absent means the uniform proposal alone, with every byte and hash as before. Components are sorted by kind and unique, the shares are integers in thousandths and sum to 1000, and a role_sets component names the role-set table by hash; the reader enforces the order, the sum and uniqueness. A usage component (ADR-020 section 4) names the UsageWeightTable by hash with its roots and per-slot floor; the reader checks the table against it at generation time.

gates.description: Optional: the pilot gate thresholds of ADR-020 section 6, all integers. A dataset report evaluates P1 to P4 against them; a publishing run fails when one is not met. P1 (mapping) is 100% for the role_sets component and carries no field here. The usage component has two optional thresholds of its own: p1_min_usage_permille (P1 for usage, the smallest mapped share over its six list kinds) and p3_min_bits_usage (P3 for usage, which falls back to p3_min_bits when absent). Absent: the numbers are reported with no verdict.

p2_min_accept_permille.description: P2: the fewest of a component's pilot draws the validator accepts, in thousandths (proposed 500).

p3_min_bits.description: P3: the integer upper bound on the probability of the most likely team under a component must be at most 2 to the minus this (proposed 40).

p4_min_strata_permille.description: P4: the unmerged strata of the plan, as a share of the uniform config's plan at the same d_max, in thousandths (proposed 750: a drop of more than a quarter fails).

p1_min_usage_permille.description: P1 for the usage component: the smallest, over the table's six list kinds, share of a kind's mass whose ids mapped, in thousandths (proposed 950). Optional: absent, the number is reported with no verdict.

p3_min_bits_usage.description: P3 for the usage component alone, when its sound bound cannot meet p3_min_bits: the same bound (the probability of the most likely team is at most 2 to the minus this). Optional: absent, p3_min_bits applies to every component.

share_permille.description: The component's share of the draws, in thousandths.

RoleSetsComponent.description: Teams from the engine's role sets (ADR-020 section 3): a species uniform over the table's entries, a role uniform among its sets, moves from the role's pool, an ability from the role's list.

share_permille.description: The component's share of the draws, in thousandths.

role_set_table_hash.description: The role-set table hash the draws read.

UsageComponent.description: Teams from the usage weight table (ADR-020 section 4): species with teammate correlation, then per member item, ability, moves and spread by weight, each categorical draw uniform with probability floor_permille.

share_permille.description: The component's share of the draws, in thousandths.

usage_table_hash.description: The usage weight table hash (usageTableHash) the draws read.

species_root.description: The integer root of w_species; the table's own derivation.species_root (a reader rule at generation time).

set_root.description: The integer root applied to the item, ability, move and spread weights when drawing: floor((ppm * 10^(6 (r - 1)))^(1/r)); 1 leaves the ppm.

floor_permille.description: The chance, in thousandths, that one categorical draw is uniform over the vocabulary instead of weighted.
